{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts undershoot prices when sentiment is positive due to lagging sentiment incorporation",
    "Model forecasts overshoot current levels when prices are rising (momentum bias)",
    "Mean reversion bias in forecasts when prices deviate far from historical mean",
    "Sentiment 1.0 (strong buy) requires 2-3% forecast adjustment upward",
    "Sentiment 0.0 (strong sell) requires 1-2% forecast adjustment downward",
    "When price change rate is accelerating, model forecasts are too conservative",
    "Forecasts converge toward mean of last 5 days when volatility is low"
] }
